summary: SES S.A. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, reporting shareholder votes at an Extraordinary General Meeting held June 17, 2026. Shareholders approved cancellation of shares repurchased under a 2023 buyback program (as amended in 2024), resulting in a corresponding reduction of share capital, and approved amendments to the articles of association regarding indemnification and meeting conduct. No terms such as stake percentage, price per share, premium, or deal value were disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate housekeeping update and does not constitute a special situation event.
